response.justification: While Bogdan is an exceptionally skilled and passionate senior engineer with impressive technical breadth and a strong open-source background, he is not a good fit for this Head of Development role. The primary reasons are a critical mismatch on core requirements: his "Basic" German proficiency does not meet the mandatory "minimum C1" level, and his resume shows no formal team leadership or project management experience, which are key responsibilities for this senior leadership position.
strengths: Exceptional technical depth and breadth across multiple languages and platforms (web, mobile, embedded).
Strong passion and proven experience with open-source technologies and community engagement.
Demonstrated architectural capability through work on high-scale microservices and founding a complex geo-data platform.
concerns: German language proficiency is listed as "Basic", which is a hard blocker against the "minimum C1" requirement.
Lacks any formal team leadership or management experience; all roles are senior individual contributors.
No explicit client-facing consulting or formal project management experience is evident.
